answer_1.quote: Following previous work, we then evaluate the model's performance on downstream benchmarks, which includes zero-shot accuracy testing on Hellaswag, LAMBADA, SIQA, PIQA, StoryCloze, and Winogrande. Additionally, we conduct 5-shot evaluation measuring exact match performance on TriviaQA, WebQuestions (WebQs), GSM8K, and Natural Questions (NaturalQs).
